label: Matsoni
note: Of Armenian origin (matz = sour, in Grigor Magistros, 11th century); on Armenia's intangible heritage list; Georgian matsoni a protected GI since 24 January 2012; the Caspian Sea yoghurt sold in Japan is said to be the same type, but a microbiota and viscosity comparison found them entirely different

about.text: Matzoon or matsoni is a fermented milk product of Armenian origin found in Armenia and Georgia. The Caspian Sea yogurt commercialized in Japan is said to be the same type of yogurt as matzoon, but a comparison of microbiota and viscosity found that the two are entirely different. Georgian matsoni has been a protected geographical indication in Georgia since 24 January 2012.
